widgets_values:
# WF-06 · H3 Fun ControlNet Union
Default: **Canny**. Prepare `wf06-source.mp4` at **1344×768, 24 FPS, 124 frames** using the guide, then set the remote server URL and Queue. The server loads H3 FL2VA and the original Union weights.

All six modes share Control → Generate Video → Save Video. Unconnected alternative branches stay idle.

Guide: `apps/ComfyUI-vLLM-Omni/docs/minimax-h3-controlnet.md`

nodes.title: Mode switching
widgets_values:
## Choose one control input
- **canny**: default Canny VIDEO → Control.control_video.
- **pose**: Pose VIDEO → Control.control_video; set control_type=pose. Install the two SDPose preprocessor weights.
- **depth / hed / mlsd**: load the corresponding prepared hint in Prepared hint → Control.control_video, then select the matching mode. See the guide for preprocessing.
- **inpaint**: disconnect control_video; connect Aligned source → source_video and Static mask → mask (or Dynamic mask → mask_video). Set control_type=inpaint and describe the edit in the prompt.

Use one mask input at a time. Structural modes can also use source + mask. Update the prompt when switching scenes.

nodes.title: Pose models and timing
widgets_values:
The included subgraph adapts the official ComfyUI SDPose video extractor. It detects people and draws body, hands, face and feet. MODEL and VAE are both required.

ComfyUI/models/checkpoints: `sdpose_wholebody_fp16.safetensors`

ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models: `rt_detr_v4-x-hgnet_fp16.safetensors`

Prepare timing and crop before extraction. Setting Create Video to 24 FPS only changes playback rate; use the guide to resample source footage. The input audio stays unconnected; Save Video preserves generated audio.

nodes.title: Prepared hints and masks
widgets_values:
Prepared hint and both mask loaders are idle until connected to the shared Control node.

Match all video inputs to the same 1344×768 canvas, crop, 24 FPS timeline and 124 frames. For a static black/white PNG select the **red** channel: white=regenerate, black=source conditioning. Dynamic masks use white/black RGB frames.

Community HED/MLSD preprocessors run outside this graph; their optional packages are not required to import it.
